subject: russian

fields.practice_item_id: stable unique string; independent from trainer_item_id
fields.exception_id: must resolve to canonical Exceptions Bank
fields.feedback: object with short answer/why and optional explanation link
fields.context_signature: stable hashable semantic label used for deduplication
fields.source_context: optional pointer to source exception/trainer context; never a long copied passage

validation_rules: exception_id exists and source exception status is source_verified/reviewed
mode supported by both schema and source exception practice_modes
alt_answers are never invented merely for learner convenience
distractors must be normatively wrong in this exact context or explicitly be alternative classification choices
context_signature unique inside exception_id + mode unless the item is intentionally a different transfer context
feedback rule_ref/explanation_id must resolve when present
practice text is original Eksamio wording and does not reproduce long copyrighted source exercises
